background: Shawbrook is a UK specialist lender funded by retail and business savings, lending on buy-to-let and specialist residential mortgages, commercial property, and to smaller companies through asset and structured finance.
synthesis: No agency rates the bank publicly, so the figures have to carry the whole judgement. Capital reads two ways against UK mid-sized banks: CET1 of 13.0% is in the bottom quarter, reflecting the risk weights on specialist property lending, while leverage of 8.7% is in the top quarter and has risen 0.5 points since 31 Dec 2023. The drift in funding is the thing to watch, LCR of 157% below the peer median after a fall of 154 points over that span and NSFR of 126% in the bottom quarter after a fall of 20 points, with CET1 broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026) — a balance sheet being run with less surplus liquidity as lending grows. Everything flagged in the last 90 days is favourable, a first half with profit up reported on 25 Sep 2026 and in August.
